findings.where: index.html default state (menuId pork_rice) and the #marginBanner shown on first load
findings.what: The page opens on a red "ต่ำกว่าเป้า" banner because pork_rice has a 36.0% store margin at benchmark prices against the 40% target.
findings.why: It demonstrates the required margin warning, but the first impression is that the owner's margin is bad. Recipe data is unchanged from the original and the coder flagged it.
findings.fix: Optional product decision: keep as is, or default to a dish that passes the target. No action required for approval.

findings.why: It is the only way to recover or diff against the original until the user accepts the result.

findings.what: Only Edge (Chromium) was tested. No real phone, screen reader, Firefox or Safari. The calculator-to-bot link was not re-run in iteration 2 beyond the baseline value of 21.
findings.why: WCAG conformance and cross-browser behavior need manual assistive-technology and browser testing.
findings.fix: Before release, do a manual screen-reader and cross-browser pass.
